parakeet: Even heaven doesn't sound like a place worth going. Not when you actually read what the Bible says about it. Because that warm, sentimental version where you reunite with your grandma, catch up with your childhood dog, and sit around a cloud-based family reunion, that's not in the Bible. That's fan fiction. The actual text paints a very different picture. Heaven biblically is not about fulfillment, it's not about rest. It's not about reunion. It's about service, slavery, endless, mindless, unquestioning service. You bow, you sing, you cast your crowns, you cry holy, holy, holy, on repeat forever, in a loop. That's not paradise, that's programming, that's divine labor with no days off.
